title: First-order thermodynamics of multi-scalar-tensor gravity
summary: We formulate a first-order thermodynamic description of Jordan-frame tensor--multi-scalar gravity. We derive the exact covariant $1+3$ split of the geometric sector and recast it as an effective imperfect fluid. The interpretation is Eckart-like: effective temperature, conductivity, entropy current, and entropy production are meaningful only on branches where the geometric dissipative variables satisfy matching and integrability conditions.
